rule: 1. Score each servable arm by dense r50 + MRR@10 on dev (the kernel-style evaluation, top 3,000 chunks).
2. The best-scoring arm is the candidate.
3. A cheaper arm (fewer bytes per chunk) replaces it only if it is within 1 point of it on r50 AND on MRR@10.
4. The chosen form is then measured on the SERVED path (evals/lexical_benchmark.py --split dev, hybrid and dense) against generation 1; the GPU generation is kept only if dev hybrid recall@50 rises.
5. The test split is scored once, after the configuration is frozen.
